summary: Schaff Trend Cycle: a MACD run through two stochastic passes, from 0 to 100, with triggers at 75 and 25.
overview: The Schaff Trend Cycle (STC) is a fast trend oscillator from 0 to 100 in its own pane. Trigger lines sit at 75 and 25.
The line is green while bullish and red while bearish, with a gradient fill from the midline.
how: First a MACD is built from 23 and 50 bar EMAs. Then a stochastic of that MACD is taken over 10 bars and smoothed with a factor of 0.5. A second stochastic pass with the same smoothing gives the final STC.
The two passes make it move quickly between the top and bottom of its range.
use: Some traders watch a cross up through 25 as an early sign of an uptrend.
Watch a cross down through 75 as an early sign of a downtrend.
Use flat lines at the top or bottom as a sign the trend is steady.
Pair it with price structure to filter quick flips.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
It can sit pinned at 0 or 100 for long stretches.
